description: React 19 component library built on Base UI and styled with Tailwind CSS v4 and CVA, with optional Motion animations. Published as one npm package, chunks-ui, with a theme.css of OKLCH design tokens.
rules: Import components from 'chunks-ui'. In React Server Components import the React-free helpers (cn, cnState, *Variants, DEFAULT_*_LABELS, mergeLabels) from 'chunks-ui/utils', because 'chunks-ui' is a client bundle.
Load the theme with @import 'chunks-ui/theme.css' right after @import 'tailwindcss'. No Tailwind plugin or config file is needed.
chunks-ui needs React 19.2+ and Tailwind CSS v4. Motion is optional: without the motion package the components fall back to CSS transitions.
Compose with the Base UI render prop. chunks-ui components do not support asChild.
Use the color prop (primary, secondary, destructive, success, warning) and the variant prop where a component offers them, before adding custom classes.
Change built-in English text with the labels prop and pass only the keys that change.
Wrap a subtree in <PortalContainerProvider value={element}> to render its popups inside that element instead of document.body.
